name: 3-phosphoinositide dependent protein kinase 1

function.text: PDPK1 encodes 3-phosphoinositide-dependent protein kinase 1. Annotated molecular activities include 3-phosphoinositide-dependent protein kinase activity and protein serine kinase activity. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction.
